verses.english: 3. The Explanation of the Hundred and Eight

verses.pali: “Pubbeva me, bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi:
verses.english: “Mendicants, before my awakening—when I was still unawakened but intent on awakening—I thought:

verses.pali: ‘katamā nu kho vedanā, katamo vedanāsamudayo, katamā vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadā, katamo vedanānirodho, katamā vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā?
verses.english: ‘What is feeling? What’s the origin of feeling? What’s the practice that leads to the origin of feeling? What’s the cessation of feeling? What’s the practice that leads to the cessation of feeling?

verses.pali: Ko vedanāya assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṁ nissaraṇan’ti?
verses.english: And what is feeling’s gratification, drawback, and escape?’

verses.pali: sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.

verses.english: Craving is the practice that leads to the origin of feeling …

verses.pali: yo vedanāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṁ. Idaṁ vedanāya nissaraṇan’”ti.
verses.english: Removing and giving up desire and greed for feeling: this is its escape.’”
